{{Top|leg}}
'''Concussion spheres''' were a projectile weapon launched from [[concussion-sphere launcher]]s. A magazine of eight concussion spheres could be loaded into each launcher. Concussion spheres were one of the many weapons installed on the ''[[Nebulon Ranger]]'', a [[Corellia StarDrive]] [[Coruscant-class Heavy Courier|''Coruscant''-class Heavy Courier]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
